source: Climate Resilient Broadcasting Rice Growing Technique, ASPIRE/IFAD, MAFF, Feb 2018
text:
Plow the field (ការភ្ជួររាស់) at least twice before sowing or transplanting. Do the first plowing at a depth of at least 15cm while soil still has some moisture, since plowing at the right moisture level helps bury weeds and disrupt overwintering pests. Do the second plowing 7-10 days before broadcasting or transplanting: spread manure or compost first, then plow it in, and level the field while the soil is evenly moist.

Two passes rather than one is worth the extra labor: a second plowing/harrowing pass before final leveling loosens the soil further, helps the field retain moisture longer into a dry spell, improves soil fertility over time, encourages deeper root penetration (which improves drought resilience), reduces how much chemical fertilizer is needed to get the same result, and generally protects the field's long-term soil condition better than a single shallow pass.
